method: 50 identical frozen inputs and prompts, two models, 100 comparison reviews. Luna receipts reused; DeepSeek supplement only.
open_design_first_request: fresh quota_exhausted; failed receipt preserved; no production fallback setting changed
recommendation: Use Luna as the default for cost/latency/citation quality in this sample, and DeepSeek for disputed or high-risk second review; preserve paired controls if testing a later batch. This pilot alone does not justify full-run accuracy claims.
limits: Human review was not blinded and covered12 purposively selected cases, not all162 model suggestions.
Latency uses historical Luna receipts and a later DeepSeek run, not simultaneous identical server load.
Luna charge is estimated from official pricing; Go cost is provider-reported balance billing, not an independently reconciled invoice.
Fifty reused-control versus fifty supplement reviews do not mean the full55651-project audit has begun.
